name: Product gallery
summary: Main image with arrows, a counter and thumbnails.
avoid: One image: just show an img.
anatomy: Stage with the image, previous/next buttons and a counter.
Thumbnails (_Gallery thumb: Default, Hover, Current, Focus).
reactProps: Each image has its own alt.
Product name. The section is called "Images {label}".
{ gallery(label), roleDescription, previous, next, image(i, n, alt) }
behaviour: Arrows and thumbnails change the image. The list loops around.
On the thumbnails arrow left/right, Home and End work.
a11y: The counter is announced (aria-live). The current thumbnail has aria-current.
One tab stop for the row of thumbnails (roving tabindex).
content: Alt describes what you see: "Sweater, back".
open: Zoom and swipe on touch do not exist yet.
